rows.en: A service that shares by default is offered only with its private mode, which Civicsmith turns on and checks on every call; if it can't confirm private mode, nothing is sent.

Not offered, because they share what is sent to them: VirusTotal uploads, Jotti, Hybrid Analysis, and the public modes of ANY.RUN, Joe Sandbox and urlscan.io. A tool whose vendor does not say whether it shares what it is sent is not offered until it does. An address check never sends the full address to anyone new: only checks that send a scrambled fragment, or Cloudflare's own. A site known to be bad: the document is still captured, as high risk, opens only in the safe view, and the check's answer is noted on it.

rewrite.screen.archive.summary: Opened when it was captured: {filed} files filed and held for review beside it, {held} already held, {notfiled} not filed, {folders} folders.
rewrite.screen.archive.alreadyheld: Already held · the same file {name} captured directly on {date}; this copy is kept as a second sighting of it
rewrite.screen.archive.folder: A folder · its {count} files are listed and filed below it
rewrite.screen.archive.refused.none: Nothing in it is filed. The archive itself stays captured exactly as it arrived, with its grade, and anyone can check why it was refused.
rewrite.screen.calculation.counts: {visited} of {n} visited: {yes} {answer}, {no} not {answer}, {unsure} could not tell
rewrite.screen.calculation.range: {share}% of the {judged} that could be judged were {answer} · exact {confidence}% range {low}% to {high}%
rewrite.screen.calculation.notsays: It does not recount the {size} ({whose} check did that), says nothing certain about any one {item} no one visited, and nothing about the {outside} {items} not {what}.
rewrite.screen.ceremony.photos.copy: Mark anyone in a photo who is not part of a finding, and any number plate. The public copy shows those areas obscured, labeled “Faces, plates and camera details removed for publication; the group holds the original”, and the original stays inside the group. Every photo a published case carries goes out without its camera details (where and when it was taken, and on which device), labeled “Camera details removed for publication; the group holds the original”. City staff at work are part of what the case is about; obscure one only with a reason.
rewrite.screen.ceremony.signs.count: One confirmation signs all {n}: the edition, its {findings} findings, and the {evidence} pieces of evidence they rest on. Each signature can be checked on its own, so a reader can trust one finding without trusting the rest.
rewrite.screen.docket.sub: The case's public record of corrections, withdrawals and orders.
rewrite.screen.group.court.field: Tell members what a court can reach
rewrite.screen.group-identity.other.field: Describe your kind of group, in a few words
rewrite.screen.group-identity.purpose.field: Why the group exists, in your own words
Also our public page and the network directory
rewrite.screen.held.waiting: {asker}'s question is waiting for {capture}. Your reason is kept on the record and shown to {asker} on the question.
rewrite.screen.help-records.must.1: Answer within {days} days whether it holds records it can release, why or why not, and when they will be ready ({cite}).
rewrite.screen.help-records.must.2: Take longer only by written notice, saying why and when, for reasons the law lists ({reasons}); never more than {extra} extra days ({cite}).
rewrite.screen.help-records.must.3: Help you focus the request: identify the records that fit it, say where they are kept, and suggest ways past practical obstacles ({cite}).
rewrite.screen.help-records.must.4: Release the rest of a record that is partly exempt ({cite}), and refuse only in writing, naming who decided ({cite2}).
rewrite.screen.help-records.must.5: Give electronic records electronically, in a format it keeps them in, when you ask ({cite}).
rewrite.screen.help-records.must.6: Charge only the direct cost of copying ({cite}); for electronic records, of producing the copy, unless it must compile, extract or program data ({cite2}). You may photograph records you inspect, with your own equipment, at no charge ({cite3}).
rewrite.screen.help-records.must.7: Never ask why you want them: access can't be limited because of the purpose of a request ({cite}).
rewrite.screen.help-records.portal.2: Each request's page shows its full text to anyone, with its dates, the department and the city's contact. Write the request so you are content for anyone to read it.
rewrite.screen.help-records.portal.3: Contact details are optional. Without them you get no updates, and you can collect the records only if the department posts them publicly or you contact it yourself.
rewrite.screen.join.language.help: Chosen from your device's setting. You can change it any time.
rewrite.screen.join.handle.help: The record shows your handle on your work. Choose it with care: it can't be changed after you join, and no one else can ever take it. It needn't be your legal name. Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, 2 to 41 of them, starting with a letter or digit. Choosing a handle: a name people know lends your work credibility and lets reporters reach you, but puts it on public cases; a pen name shields you from pressure, while the administrators still know who you are.
rewrite.screen.join.codes.after: When you join, you get ten recovery codes, shown once: save them, they are how you get back in if you forget your password. Then you are signed in and your group's home opens, with a short guided start you can take or leave.
rewrite.screen.money.didnotmove: did not move: a {phase} figure, adopted {date}
rewrite.screen.money.gap.to: Undetermined: not stated in {source}, the only source holding this figure.
rewrite.screen.people.notmembers: The people and organizations your group's record follows: officials, staff, companies and public bodies. Your own group's members are not listed here; they are under Settings › Members.
rewrite.screen.people.today.seeded: added at setup from your group's place
rewrite.screen.person.expunge.statement: This removes the recorded value for good. It cannot be undone, by you or anyone: the value is gone from this page, from every question that cited it, and from every export. A marker stays where it was: "Removed where the law requires, {date}, by {member}". Published cases are not changed; a court order for those is complied with on the docket.
rewrite.screen.places.wanted.field: A place you want that isn't listed (optional)
rewrite.screen.places.wanted.help: Kept in your group's Civicsmith and never sent anywhere. When an update brings its rules and offices, administrators are told once in their queue and can choose it above.
rewrite.screen.proceeding.login.note: The court's register needs a login, so new filings come only by a member's own capture.
rewrite.screen.projectai.account.suspended: Your sign-in no longer serves {project}. A second member joined, and a sign-in serves a project only while it has one member. Members' acts here now use their own accounts, or the group's key. Add an API key to give the project its own account again; if the project returns to just you, your sign-in serves it again.
rewrite.screen.projectai.notice.head: Before your first question here
rewrite.screen.recovery.held: You hold recovery codes: {remaining} of {total} unused, issued {date}.
rewrite.screen.recovery.shown: Save these now: they are shown only this once. Keep them somewhere only you can reach, apart from your password. Civicsmith keeps only a fingerprint of each, so it can never show them again.
rewrite.screen.reset.keeps: Your handle and everything you did stay as they are, and every other sign-in of yours ends. {name} can't see the password you choose. Your recovery codes still work; if you have lost them too, get ten new ones in Settings › Recovery codes once you are in.
rewrite.screen.reset.dead.what: It was used already, it expired, or an administrator withdrew it. Ask an administrator for a new one, in person or however your group talks. Nothing was changed.
rewrite.screen.review-copy.heading: Share Edition {edition} for review
rewrite.screen.review-outside.heading: A review copy from {group}
rewrite.screen.request.describe: Describe the records, not why you want them. The law doesn't let the office limit access because of why you ask ({cite}), and the city's portal shows this text to anyone.
rewrite.screen.request.howsend.1: Open the city's public records portal ({portal}) and choose “{button}”.
rewrite.screen.request.howsend.2: Paste the approved text as the request description, and choose the department: {department}.
rewrite.screen.request.howsend.3: Contact details are optional. Without them the request still goes in, but the city can't send you updates or ask you to clarify, and you can't sign in to collect the records. Give the address your group uses for its requests; staff see what you give.
rewrite.screen.standard.notyet: Not a standard until a member adopts it.
rewrite.screen.ties.says.name.choice: Naming me by my handle: “{handle}, who worked on this case, is {tie}.”
rewrite.screen.ties.says.group.choice: Without naming me: “A member of the group who worked on this case is {tie}.”
rewrite.screen.timeline.order.evidence: More evidence could order them: a passage that gives either one its day ({examples}), or a source that says which came first. Until a source orders them, both are kept as they are, never guessed into order; when one does, the timeline names it, and a source that disagrees is shown beside it, in tension.
rewrite.shell.unavailable.nothing.says: This address doesn't lead to anything in your group's Civicsmith. It may have been typed wrong, or the link is old.
rewrite.shell.unavailable.notyours.says: It exists, or it may not: either way it isn't something you can see. A hidden project shows only to its own members; ask its owner if you think you should be in it.
rewrite.shell.unavailable.unreachable.title: Your group's Civicsmith can't be reached
rewrite.shell.unavailable.unreachable.says: Your device is offline, or your group's Civicsmith isn't answering. Nothing you did is lost: what you saved is kept there, and what you were typing is still on this page.
rewrite.screen.wizards.copy.note: A copy becomes your group's own wizard: a draft until approved, like any wizard your group writes. The original stays as it is and is still offered; a required wizard stays required. The copy shows what it is based on, and when Civicsmith's original changes, your wizard editors are told and can bring the change across.
